description: Agent Intelligence — One evidence-aware agent entry point. Directly orchestrates Agent Web Research and optionally Agent Commerce Hunter without extra platform fees. Combines attributed news, academic records, optional supplied public HTML and PDF evidence, optional eBay offers, policy excerpts and user-provided profit scenarios; customer-funded AI synthesis is optional. One call costs 0.01 USDC on Base x402; customer-owned provider credentials use X-Provider-Key header where needed.

analysis.description: Optional true using X-AI-Key; otherwise false

commerce_query.description: Optional eBay sourcing query; requires customer eBay OAuth token

currency.description: Required for profit: same 3-letter currency for all amounts

page_url.description: Optional public HTTPS HTML evidence source

pdf_url.description: Optional public selectable-text PDF (up to three pages)

previous_hash.description: Optional SHA-256 prior semantic hash when page_url is provided

selling_price.description: Optional hypothetical selling price; provide unit_cost and currency too

unit_cost.description: Optional known goods cost in same currency as selling_price

name: api_agent_intelligence
